title: Vinyl Beat CDs, but Streaming Still Owns Music
hook: The physical-format comeback is real, but it is not a takeover.
closing: Vinyl won the physical contest while streaming kept control of the larger market.
question: Do you still own a CD?

segments.say: Vinyl revenue reached about two and a half times CD revenue. The comeback beat its closest physical rival.
Vinyl sold 41 million albums. The revenue win also appeared in the number of physical records people bought.
Streaming still captured 84 percent of recorded-music revenue. Vinyl beat CDs inside a physical market that remains much smaller.
